subject: crystal_maiden_crystal_nova
description_zh: 召唤具有破坏性的冰爆，降低目标区域内的敌人的移动速度。
description_en: A burst of damaging frost slows enemy movement in the targeted area.
notes_zh: 冰霜新星在持续时间内提供目标区域的视野。

subject: crystal_maiden_freezing_field
description_zh: 持续施法 - 以水晶室女为中心召唤%num_explosions%次随机冰爆轰炸敌人，将其减速并造成大量伤害。持续%abilitychanneltime%秒。
description_en: CHANNELED - Surrounds Crystal Maiden with %num_explosions% random icy explosions that slow enemies and deal massive damage. Lasts %abilitychanneltime% seconds.
notes_zh: 减速效果对作用范围内所有敌人有效，即使他们没有受到冰爆的伤害（效果持续%slow_duration%秒）。
每%explosion_interval_tooltip%秒产生一次爆炸。

scepter.zh: 使自身在极寒领域期间可以移动、施法和攻击。仍然可以被敌人打断。在此期间移动速度降低%shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%%。冰爆总数提升%shard_bonus_explosion%%%。对极寒领域内停留超过%frostbite_delay%秒的所有单位都会施加冰封禁制。
scepter.en: Allows you to move, cast and attack during Freezing Field. Can still be interrupted by enemies. You move %shard_self_movement_speed_slow_pct%%% slower during this. Increases total number of explosions by %shard_bonus_explosion%%%. Applies Frostbite to any unit that has been standing in the Freezing Field for over %frostbite_delay%s.

subject: nevermore_requiem
description_zh: 影魔将捕获的灵魂中最多%max_soul_release%个进行聚集，以多道魔能的形式释放。若距离影魔过近将受到数道魔能的伤害。每道魔能对敌方单位造成伤害的同时，还将造成恐惧和减速效果，并且降低魔法抗性，持续%requiem_slow_duration%秒，最高可达%requiem_slow_duration_max%秒。通过支配死灵收集的每个灵魂会为魂之挽歌创造一道魔能。死亡时会自动释放魂之挽歌，不占用主动大招的冷却时间。
description_en: Shadow Fiend gathers up to %max_soul_release% of his captured souls to release them as lines of demonic energy. Units near Shadow Fiend when the souls are released can be damaged by several lines of energy. Any unit damaged by Requiem of Souls will be feared and have its movement speed and magic resistance reduced for %requiem_slow_duration% seconds for each line hit up to a maximum of %requiem_slow_duration_max%. Lines of energy are created for every soul captured through Necromastery.  Requiem of Souls is automatically cast whenever Shadow Fiend dies, regardless of its cooldown.
notes_zh: 影魔收集的灵魂中，每%requiem_soul_conversion%个会产生一道伤害波。
死亡时释放的魂之挽歌不会施加恐惧和减速效果。

scepter.zh: 降低冷却时间，并且魂之挽歌可以回归影魔。影魔会回复与回归伤害值相等的生命。
scepter.en: Reduces cooldown and causes Requiem of Souls to return back to Shadow Fiend. The wave back to Shadow Fiend heals him for all the damage it dealt.

subject: morphling_adaptive_strike_agi
description_zh:
用猛烈的水波打击一个敌方单位，将其击退并眩晕，同时造成伤害，伤害量为基础伤害加上变体精灵自身敏捷值乘以伤害系数的额外伤害。如果变体精灵的敏捷比力量高50%%，将采用最高伤害系数。

击退距离和眩晕时间是根据变体精灵的力量值。如果变体精灵的力量比敏捷高50%%，将造成最大击退和眩晕。
description_en:
Launches a surge of water toward an enemy unit, stunning them, knocking them back, and dealing base damage plus additional damage based on Morphling's agility times a multiplier.  If Morphling's agility is 50% higher than strength, the maximum agility multiplier is used.

Knockback distance and stun duration are based on Morphling's strength. If his strength is 50% higher than his agility, the maximum knockback distance and stun duration is used.
notes_zh: 弹道移动速度为%projectile_speed%。

subject: pudge_rot
description_zh: 能够造成持续伤害并减缓敌人移动速度的毒性云雾——同时对敌军和自身造成伤害。
description_en: A toxic cloud that deals intense damage and slows movement--harming not only enemy units but Pudge himself.
notes_zh: 使用腐烂不会打断持续施法。
腐烂能伤害隐身单位。
即使帕吉在开启腐烂后被沉默，腐烂也不会关闭。
腐烂的对己伤害不致死。

scepter.zh: 腐烂的作用范围提升%bonus_rot_radius%，伤害提升%bonus_rot_damage%点，并且可以降低敌人的%scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%生命回复。
scepter.en: Increases Rot radius by %bonus_rot_radius%, damage by %bonus_rot_damage%, and causes it to reduce enemy Health Restoration by %scepter_rot_regen_reduction_pct%%%.

subject: razor_storm_surge
description_zh: 被攻击时拥有几率、每次受到指向性技能时都会释放一道叉状闪电，击中目标和附近其他敌人，优先打击与目标类型相同的单位，造成伤害并减缓移动速度。
description_en: There's a chance when attacked, and always when targeted with a spell, to release a forked lightning that strikes the target and other nearby enemies, prioritizing the unit type of the attacker, dealing damage and slowing movement speed.
notes_zh: 这个技能造成的伤害被视为反弹伤害。反弹伤害不提供任何吸血，而且无法反弹。

shard.zh: 风暴之眼开启时，打击几率为%eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%倍，打击冷却时间减少%strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%秒，而且闪电会打击风暴之眼范围内所有敌人。单次伤害不会对同个敌人施加两次。
shard.en: While Eye of the Storm is active, strike chance is %eye_of_the_storm_chance_multiplier%x as high, strike cooldown is reduced by %strike_cd_reduction_during_storm%s, and Lightning strikes all enemies within Eye of the Storm's radius. Does not apply to the same enemy twice from a single instance.

subject: windrunner_powershot
description_zh: 持续施法 - 风行者为她的弓蓄力，射出一支强力的箭矢，最长可蓄力%abilitychanneltime%秒，其间可以打断蓄力，蓄力时间越长，箭矢伤害越高。这支箭会对穿过的所有敌方单位造成伤害和减速效果，并破坏树木。每伤害一个单位，箭矢的伤害和减速效果都会降低。
description_en: CHANNELED - Windranger charges her bow for up to %abilitychanneltime% second for a single powerful shot, which deals more damage the longer it is charged. The arrow damages and slows enemies' movement speed along its path. For each enemy that Powershot hits, its damage and slow is reduced.
notes_zh: 强力击将摧毁作用范围内的树木。

subject: zuus_heavenly_jump
description_zh: 宙斯作出神圣一跳，向前跳跃并震击最近的可见敌人（以英雄优先），造成伤害，并减缓其移动速度、攻击速度。宙斯获得附近%vision_radius%范围的顺畅视野，持续3秒。
description_en: Zeus performs a Heavenly Jump, leaping forward and shocking the closest visible nearby enemy (prioritizing heroes), dealing damage as well as reducing their movement and attack speed. Zeus gets %vision_radius% unobstructed vision around him for 3 seconds.

subject: kunkka_tidebringer
description_zh: 昆卡的传奇之剑使他的下一次攻击附加额外的攻击力并在前方造成大范围的分裂攻击伤害。
description_en: Kunkka's legendary sword grants increased damage and cleaves a large area of effect in front of him for a single strike.

subject: kunkka_ghostship
description_zh: 召唤一艘幽灵船驶过战场，直到撞成粉碎，残骸周围的敌人将会因撞击受到伤害并眩晕。被幽灵船碰到的友军会获得2倍效果的统帅朗姆酒。
description_en: Summons a ghostly ship that sails through the battle before smashing apart, damaging and stunning all enemies caught near the wreckage.Allied heroes touched by the Ghostship are given a %rum_factor%x strong swig of The Admiral's Rum.
notes_zh: 幽灵船实际的碰撞范围比船本身大。
幽灵船的移动速度为%ghostship_speed%。

scepter.zh: 幽灵船在目标地点以%fleet_interval%秒的间隔产生%fleet_count%艘船组成的舰队。每艘船现在还会从左舷和右舷发射%num_cannon_volleys%波炮弹，穿过敌人时造成%cannon_ball_damage_pct%%%幽灵船伤害。
scepter.en: Ghostship creates a fleet of %fleet_count% ships at the target point on a %fleet_interval% second interval. Each ship now also fires %num_cannon_volleys% waves of cannonballs from the port and starboard side that deal %cannon_ball_damage_pct%%% of Ghostship's damage as they pass through enemies.

subject: lich_chain_frost
description_zh: 释放一个在敌人间弹跳至多%jumps%次的霜冻之球，每次击中敌人后都会造成伤害和减速效果。每次弹跳后会提升后续的伤害。连环霜冻无法弹跳时会停留在上个目标身上，如果出现新目标可以再次弹跳。
description_en: Releases an orb of frost that bounces between nearby enemy units up to %jumps% times, slowing and damaging each time it hits. Each bounce increases the damage for the subsequent bounces. Chain Frost lingers on its last target if it fails to bounce and can bounce again if new targets become available.
notes_zh: 连环霜冻无法被躲避。
连环霜冻的移动速度为%projectile_speed%。
连环霜冻不会弹跳到墓碑召唤的僵尸身上。

subject: lion_impale
description_zh: 岩石尖刺在地上沿一条直线穿刺而出。敌方单位被抛向空中，落地时被眩晕并受到伤害。
description_en: Rock spikes burst from the earth along a straight path. Enemy units are hurled into the air, then are stunned and take damage when they fall.
notes_zh: 尖刺的移动速度是每秒%speed%码。
不会触发法术抵抗或法术反弹。

subject: queenofpain_shadow_strike
description_zh: 投出一把淬毒匕首，造成大量初始伤害，并持续造成后续伤害。中毒的单位移动速度被减缓，持续%duration%秒。每%damage_interval%秒会再造成一次伤害。
description_en: Hurls a poisoned dagger which deals large initial damage, and then deals damage over time. The poisoned unit has its movement speed slowed for %duration% seconds.  An instance of damage is dealt every %damage_interval% seconds.
notes_zh: 受到作用的单位在持续时间内将逐秒缓慢地恢复至初始移动速度。
受到暗影突袭作用的单位在生命值低于最大值25%时可以被队友反补。

scepter.zh: 暗影突袭变为%aoe_radius%范围型技能。暗影突袭效果结束后或重新施加给敌方英雄时，目标将放出痛苦尖叫，伤害附近所有敌人。
scepter.en: Causes Shadow Strike to become a %aoe_radius% AoE Spell. When Shadow Strike ends or is re-applied to an enemy Hero, the target emits a Scream of Pain, hitting any nearby enemies.

subject: phantom_assassin_stifling_dagger
description_zh: 对敌方单位掷出一把匕首，减缓其移动速度，并造成物理伤害，数值为%base_damage%+幻影刺客攻击伤害的%attack_factor_tooltip%%%，同时继承物品和技能的攻击效果。
description_en: Throws a dagger slowing the enemy unit's movement speed, dealing %base_damage%+%attack_factor_tooltip%%% of Phantom Assassin's attack damage as physical damage and applying attack effects from items and abilities.
notes_zh: 如果攻击效果为几率触发，匕首的触发几率与原几率相同。
减益免疫下的敌人不会受到窒碍短匕的减速影响。
窒碍短匕在行进途中和击中目标时都会提供附近的视野。

subject: leshrac_lightning_storm
description_zh: 召唤一片闪电风暴攻击目标敌方单位，并跳跃到附近的敌方单位。被攻击的敌人将会被降低移动速度。
description_en: Summons a lightning storm that blasts the target enemy unit, then strikes any nearby enemy units. Struck enemies have their move speed slowed.

subject: leshrac_greater_lightning_storm
description_zh: 使拉席克和范围内所有敌人变为虚无状态，他们无法攻击，并且承受的魔法伤害增加，移动速度被减缓。拉席克的移动速度得到提升，而不是减缓。拉席克受到的魔法伤害不会增加。
description_en: Causes Leshrac and all nearby enemies to turn ethereal, preventing them from attacking, slowing them, and making them take more magic damage. Increases Leshrac's speed rather than reducing it. Does not cause Leshrac to take amplified damage.

subject: life_stealer_open_wounds
description_zh: 噬魂鬼撕裂一个敌方单位，减缓受害者的移动速度，并使所有友军在攻击该单位时根据造成的伤害回复一定比例的生命。受害者在持续时间内逐渐恢复移动速度。
description_en: Lifestealer rends an enemy unit, slowing the victim's movement speed and allowing all allies to regain health for a percentage of the damage they deal to that unit. The victim recovers movement speed over the duration.
notes_zh: 撕裂伤口的减速有8个独立的阶段：50%/50%/40%/30%/20%/10%/10%/10%，每过一秒就会进入下个阶段，减速效果不断降低。
治疗数值会被噬魂鬼的生命回复增强效果提升。

subject: dark_seer_surge
description_zh: 为一个友方目标注入能量，使其在短时间内移动速度爆发，并且获得相位移动状态。允许单位达到移动速度上限，并且无法被减速。
description_en: Charges a target friendly unit with power, giving it a brief burst of phased movement speed. Allows the unit to reach maximum movement speed and cannot be slowed.
notes_zh: 奔腾的单位不受减速影响，除非奔腾效果消失。

shard.zh: 奔腾单位的身后留下一道路径，作用范围为%trail_radius%，持续%trail_duration%秒，对附近的敌人造成%trail_move_slow%%%减速，并且每秒造成%trail_damage%点伤害，伤害间隔为%trail_damage_interval%秒。可以设为多样施法（右键点击技能栏图标），禁止留下路径。
shard.en: Surged units leave behind a %trail_radius% radius trail that lasts %trail_duration%s, slows enemies around it by %trail_move_slow%%% and deals %trail_damage% damage per second in %trail_damage_interval%s intervals. Can be put on alt-cast to disable the trail.

subject: enchantress_enchant
description_zh:
魅惑魔女诱惑一个敌人。如果目标是英雄，将被驱散，其移动速度也会被减缓，持续%slow_duration%秒，而魅惑魔女和她的单位攻击目标时拥有额外攻击距离。

如果目标是非英雄单位，魅惑魔女会将其控制，并获得%xp_gain_pct%%%相应的击杀经验。魅惑魔女控制的非英雄单位最多持续%dominate_duration%秒。

驱散类型：弱驱散
description_en:
Enchantress charms an enemy. If the enemy is a hero, they are dispelled and slowed for %slow_duration%s, and Enchantress and her units gain bonus attack range against the target.

 If the enemy is a creep, she brings it under her control and receives %xp_gain_pct%%% of their experience bounty.  Enchantress can control creeps for up to %dominate_duration%s. 

DISPEL TYPE: Basic Dispel
notes_zh: 可以转化幻象。

scepter.zh: 魅惑魔女可以同时控制多个非英雄单位。
scepter.en: Enchantress can control multiple creeps at a time.

subject: night_stalker_void
description_zh: 制造一个伤害性的虚空，对一个敌方单位造成减速及伤害。夜晚时虚空可以造成短暂眩晕，打断持续施法，并且效果的持续时间更长。
description_en: Creates a damaging void that slows an enemy unit and deals damage. At night, Void also mini-stuns, interrupting channeling abilities, and its effects lasts longer.
notes_zh: 虚空在白天不会对敌人造成眩晕。

shard.zh: 虚空现在影响目标范围内所有单位。
shard.en: Void now affects all units in a radius around the target.

subject: bounty_hunter_shuriken_toss
description_zh: 向一个敌方单位掷出一枚致命的飞镖，对目标造成伤害，并且减缓目标的移动速度。只要目标周围%bounce_aoe%范围内存在被追踪术标记的单位，飞镖就能向其弹射。
description_en: Hurls a deadly shuriken at an enemy unit, dealing damage and slowing the target's movement speed.  The shuriken will bounce to any Tracked units who are within a %bounce_aoe% radius of each other.

scepter.zh: 提升施法距离并且击中时施加忍术。
scepter.en: Increases cast range and applies Jinada on hit.

subject: jakiro_liquid_ice
description_zh: 杰奇洛的攻击使他的敌人受寒，减缓其移动速度，持续%duration%秒，并且被杰奇洛的攻击和其他技能击中后承受额外伤害。这个效果对建筑无效。与液态火共用冷却时间。
description_en: Jakiro chill his enemies with ice added to his attack, slowing movement for %duration% seconds and increasing damage taken from Jakiro's attacks and abilities. This effect does not apply to buildings. Shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

shard.zh: 杰奇洛的液态冰没有魔法消耗，并且不再和液态火共用冷却时间。
shard.en: Jakiro's Liquid Frost has no mana cost and no longer shares a cooldown with Liquid Fire.

subject: spectre_haunt
description_zh: 创造一个复仇鬼影分别攻击每个敌方英雄。鬼影无法控制，受到额外伤害，造成的伤害低于幽鬼本体。鬼影移动无视地形。子技能空降可以将本体传送至幻象，并将其摧毁。
description_en: Creates a spectral nemesis to haunt all enemy Heroes.Haunt illusions are uncontrollable, take extra damage, and deal less damage than Spectre herself.  They ignore terrain.The Reality sub-ability may be used to teleport to the illusion, destroying it.

scepter.zh: 幽鬼第一次对鬼影重重的幻象使用空降时，目标附近%fear_aoe%范围内的敌人会被恐惧，朝远离幽鬼的方向奔跑%fear_duration%秒，并且移动速度降低%fear_movespeed_slow%%%。冷却时间减少%scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%秒。
scepter.en: The first time Spectre uses Reality on a Haunt illusion, enemies in a %fear_aoe% area around the target are Feared away from Spectre for %fear_duration%s and have their movement speed slowed by %fear_movespeed_slow%%%.Reduces cooldown by %scepter_cooldown_reduction_tooltip%s.

subject: invoker_ghost_walk
description_zh: 祈求者操纵冰电之力围绕自身，使自己隐形并且获得生命和魔法恢复。各种元素的不平衡导致附近敌人的移动速度被减缓，减速效果取决于冰元素的等级，并使祈求者自身移动速度减缓，减速效果与雷元素等级成反比。
description_en: Invoker manipulates the ice and electrical energies around him, rendering his body invisible and gaining health and mana regen. The elemental imbalance created as a consequence slows nearby enemies based on the level of Quas, and slows Invoker as well based on the level of Wex.
notes_zh: 减速效果对减益免疫状态下的单位无效。

shard.zh: 现在幽灵漫步还会对范围内的敌方英雄施加寒冰之墙的每秒伤害。
shard.en: Ghost Walk now also applies the Ice Wall Damage Per Second to enemy heroes in its area of effect.

subject: lycan_summon_wolves
description_zh: 召唤%wolf_count%头精灵狼为狼人战斗。3级精灵狼获得永久隐身，4级精灵狼获得致残技能，20%几率使目标残废，造成每秒8点伤害，并失去60攻击速度，持续4秒。
description_en: Summons %wolf_count% wolves to aid Lycan in battle. At level 3, wolves gain Permanent Invisibility, and at level 4 wolves gain Cripple that gives 20% chance to cripple the target, causing 8 damage per second and lose 60 attack speed for 4 seconds.
notes_zh: 使用此技能后原来的狼群将会死亡。

shard.zh: 召唤的精灵狼的数量提升。所有召唤的精灵狼获得健步如飞技能，这个主动技能使精灵狼获得相位移动，闪避，移动速度和攻击速度。
shard.en: Increases the number of wolves summoned. Grants all summoned wolves the ability Hightail, an active ability that gives them phased movement, evasion, movespeed, and attack speed.
